{{Quote|Bakura is under attack by an alien invasion force from outside your domain. Estimate five cruisers, several dozen ships, over 1000 small fighters. Unknown technology. We have lost half our defense force and all outersystem outposts. Holonet transmissions to Imperial Center and Death Star Two have gone unanswered. Urgent, repeat urgent, send Stormtroopers.|Transmission by Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]]|<ref name="TTAB" />}}
The '''invasion of Bakura''' was the attempt by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] to invade the remote [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The battle took place during and days after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Only the timely arrival of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|Virgillian Escort Carrier]] ''[[Flurry]]'' and its unlikely alliance with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] stationed at Bakura temporarily drove the [[Ssi-ruu]]k to fringes of the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]], thus saving Bakura for the time being.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You must go. If you do not attend to the matter—personally, Luke—Bakura—and all worlds, both Allied and Imperial—will know a far greater disaster than you can imagine.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], warning Skywalker|<ref name="TTAB" />}}
For millennia, the saurian [[Ssi-ruu]]k had ruled an isolated [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium|interstellar domain]] in the distant reaches of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Their technology relied on [[entechment]]—whereby the souls of a sentient being were drained into a mechanical conduit. However by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], resources were becoming scarce in their isolated region of space.<ref name="TABS" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Ssi-ruuvi's supreme ruler—the [[Shreeftut]]—received visions through the Force of a hooded [[Human/Legends|Human]] who revealed himself to be [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ruler of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TABS" /> He offered the Ssi-ruuvi dozens of worlds and millions of Humans to entech, in exchange for the use of Ssi-ruuvi technology. The shreeftut agreed. In response, they decided to venture into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] where they [[Battle of G'rho|conquered]] the small Human colony of [[G'rho]]; capturing numerous members of the populace for entechment.<ref name="TABS" /><ref name="TTAB" />

Among their captives was a human boy named [[Dev Sibwarra]], whom the Elder [[Sh'tk'ith]] brainwashed through mind manipulation techniques. What astounded them was the boy possessed [[The Force/Legends|strange powers]] to sense others. From the boy, they learnt that humans had a longer containment time when enteched and could last longer than most other species.<ref name="TTAB" />

Over the next years the invaders attacked several other colonies and enteched the small populations. The Empire covered up these incidents, blaming Rebels or citing them as various disasters. The Ssi-ruuvi armada was en route towards another small colony world when Sibwarra felt the death of the Emperor during the Battle of Endor. Now that the pact that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had once forged was no longer in effect, the Ssi-ruuk set course for [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], a heavily industrialized and populated world in the [[Shiritoku Spur]].<ref name="TABS" />

The fleet was only a small advance group of the real Ssi-ruuvi fleet, and was running low on resources. A victory was necessary for the future invasion to happen. While the battleships engaged the Imperial forces, the [[Sh'ner-class planetary assault carrier|planetary attack carrier]] and the [[Cr'ee'ei|construction ship]] stayed behind near [[Arden]].<ref name="TTAB" /><ref name="TABS" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|If you could throw a cone of ships into the gap between the Ssi-ruuk's three central cruisers, it could inspire them to retreat. It would buy us time.|Pter Thanas to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TTAB" />}}
===Six-day siege===
The Imperial fleet at Bakura was taken completely by surprise. Since the only threats so far had been pirates, a full-scale invasion was too much for the outdated fleet. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Pter Thanas]] still obeyed his orders and defended the planet while [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] requested reinforcements.<ref name="TABS" />

[[File:Message_drone_EGD.jpg|thumb|left|A messenger drone.]]
[[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] requests to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] were left unanswered, so Nereus decided to use a different method: He launched an antiquated [[Elegance message drone|messenger drone]] to Endor, knowing that the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] had been there to visit the Death Star, but still unaware that Palpatine was already dead.<ref name="TABS" /><ref name="TTAB" />

In the meantime, Bakura's defense force was slaughtered: [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were almost always destroyed while the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were first disabled, then captured and the crews [[Entechment|enteched]]. All system-wide colonies and outposts, including the one on [[Bakura-6]] were destroyed. Recovery teams found no bodies or survivors, but most of them were captured, too. Only a few returned to Bakura. Governor Nereus - an expert on non-human [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] - tried to wipe out the Ssi-ruuk by infecting his men. However, the bodies of enteched prisoners were disposed too fast for this tactic to have any effect.<ref name="TABS" /><ref name="TTAB" />

When the Rebels would finally arrive, only the ''[[Dominant]]'', two gunships and a few damaged [[IR-3F-class light frigate/Legends|patrol boats]] and TIEs were left. The populace had been prepared to leave the cities and hide in the mountains as the Ssi-ruuk launched their final attack.<ref name="TABS" /><ref name="TTAB" />

To fulfill the demands of entechment, all bodies, including those wounded or captured alive, were taken back onboard to the entechment labs onboard the Ssi-ruuvi capital ships. This practice baffled the local Bakuran and Imperial recovery crew. Due to his ability to communicate with the predominantly human prisoners in their [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|native language]], Dev was pressed into service at the [[entechment rig]] on deck 16 throughout the night shift.<ref name="TTAB" />

Accompanied by [[Entechment Master|Master]] [[Firwirrung]], Dev played an active role in "calming" the entechment subjects while Firwirrung carried out the mechanical process of "transferring" life sources. These life sources would be used to power battle droids. Among those enteched was a wounded male [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who attempted to persuade Dev to not carry out the procedure. Brainwashed into believing in the benefits of entechment, he merely brushed aside the man's pleadings. Later, a female prisoner was killed during an escape attempt. Thoroughly indoctrinated, Dev merely sighed at the loss.<ref name="TTAB" />

In an attempt to persuade the Bakurans to capitulate, the Ssi-ruuk transmitted a holo-recording from Dev Sibwarra, who told them of the fate they would soon experience—that of entechment—and although Sibwarra described it as an eternal release, the Bakurans knew that was a lie.<ref name="TTAB" />

===Rebel Intervention===
The messenger drone arrived at Endor while the Alliance was reestablishing their sensor perimeter, literally the day after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Despite the fact that the message came from a relatively unimportant world, it opened a great opportunity for the Rebels; Bakura had only been occupied for a few years, so the people could still remember their independence. Bakura also had a large repulsorlift industry, and the Imperial garrison only had outdated equipment available. The Alliance also saw an opportunity to prove to the citizens of the galaxy that the Rebels were not the brutal terrorists as portrayed by Imperial propaganda. With the Imperial fleet in disarray after Endor, Bakura could only expect reinforcements in a matter of weeks - too late for the remote planet.<ref name="TTAB" />

[[File:Flurry.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rebel flagship ''Flurry''.]]
A small carrier group was assembled, consisting of the ''Flurry'', an Alliance Escort Carrier fresh from the [[Virgillian Civil War]] equipped with the experimental [[Battle Analysis Computer]], five [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian Gunships]], a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]], 20 [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], three [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], four [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Princess Leia Organa was chosen as diplomat and Commander Skywalker, despite his injuries, as military commander. Early the next day, the small fleet left for Bakura with the mission to defeat the unknown attacker and bring Bakura over to the Alliance.<ref name="TTAB" />

Despite Captain [[Tessa Manchisco]]'s impatience, the task force first dropped out of hyperspace outside the system to scan the area. After contacting the Imperial commander, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Pter Thanas]], Skywalker decided to intervene, but sent the ''Falcon'' to wait at Bakura-6, since the security of the only diplomat had a higher priority.<ref name="TTAB" />

Skywalker microjumped to Bakura at the same time that the Ssi-ruuk attempted their final push towards the planet. Starfighter groups [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold]] attacked a lone [[Wurrif-class light cruiser|''Wurrif''-class light cruiser]] while [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Group]] split up: [[Red Leader/Legends|One]] through [[Red Four/Legends|Four]] secured an escape corridor for the advancing squadrons while the rest protected the ''Flurry''. While the Alliance fighters tried to lure the enemy away from the planet, Skywalker reached out with the Force and sensed two presences being extinguished aboard the [[Ssi-ruu]]vi [[Swarm-class battle droid|droid fighters]] by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. This startled the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and he opened himself to the Force once more: when [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] eliminated several fighters at once, Skywalker [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] ''human'' force signatures.<ref name="TTAB" />

[[File:Carrack_Cruiser_FFno106.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Carrack''-class cruiser, like the ''Dominant''.]]
Only moments afterward, the BAC marked the Ssi-ruuvi cruiser as vulnerable and Skywalker had to divert his attention back to the battlefield; he ordered Rogue Squadron to engage, only to have them abort as the cruiser launched a new wave of fighters. In the meantime, Imperial Commander Pter Thanas had made good use of the reprieve and organized his ships into a counter-offensive formation.<ref name="TTAB" />

Suddenly Skywalker [[Precognition/Legends|felt danger]] in the force and he saw an enemy [[Fw'Sen-class picket ship|picket ship]] approaching Rogue Squadron as they made another attack run on the cruiser. Skywalker tried to warn Antilles and sent the remaining fighters of Red Group into battle, but due to heavy Ssi-ruuvi jamming, the orders were garbled. Rogue Squadron still managed to evade, but two X-wings flew right into the cannons of the picket ship and were destroyed. With the ''Flurry'' lacking a starfighter screen, the Ssi-ruuk sent masses of their droid starfighters against the Alliance cruiser.<ref name="TTAB" />

Leaving the defense of the ship to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Manchisco, Luke Skywalker once again opened himself to the Force. He gained an insight how the droid fighters operated and felt the constant agony of the enslaved souls. He found one specific fighter and planted the suggestion in it that it was better to die than to live in enslavement. The enteched soul understood and rammed itself into another one, a maneuver that allowed Antilles to escape.<ref name="TTAB" />

Only moments later the ''Flurry'' losts its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. Skywalker recalled all starfighters, but last-minute help came from another side: After escaping a few remaining battle droids near Bakura-6, [[General/Legends|General]] Solo had decided to join the main fleet and jumped to Bakura. The ''Falcon'' emerged from hyperspace near the ''Flurry'' and destroyed several fighters and a picket ship.<ref name="TTAB" />

After the Falcon's intervention, the battle began to slow down. Red Squadron, under guidance from Skywalker and the BAC, managed to finally destroy the cruiser. Meanwhile, Sibwarra sensed the arrival of a powerful Force-strong Jedi among the new arrivals—later revealed to be Skywalker. However, he refrained from telling his superior Bluescale since it meant confessing a guilty "secret habit". With these unexpected losses, the Ssi-ruuk retreated to the edge of the system.<ref name="TTAB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We lost a cruiser. Nearly all the new drone fighters are gone. We're having to waste humans to protect our remaining ships. We must analyze the newcomers' tactics before going in again. This group is different. Different ship types, different command style.|Elder [[Sh'tk'ith]] to Dev Sibwarra|<ref name="TTAB" />}}
[[File:Bluescale.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Elder Sh'tk'ith, Bluscale.]]
The Ssi-ruuk had completely underestimated the Rebel forces and were forced to make an emergency jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the first time since [[Battle of Cattamascar|Cattamascar]]. They sustained considerable losses including a cruiser and several drone fighters from attacks by the Alliance ships. Additionally they had lost almost all superior human-enteched starfighters and without new prisoners were unable to power up, or even build new ones. This unexpected change forced the Ssi-ruuvi leadership to analyze the newcomers' different tactics, starships and command style.<ref name="TTAB" /><ref name="TABS" />

Having helped beat off the Ssi-ruuvi attack on the system, the Alliance ships were holding position near the planet. The few remaining Imperial patrol craft and half of the TIEs required extensive repairs at the Orbital Station, but were later integrated into the combined defense grid. Following the Ssi-ruuvi withdrawal, Leia Organa contacted the planetary government and was able to arrange a meeting between the Rebel Alliance delegation and Governor Nereus, as well as the [[Bakuran Senate]].<ref name="TABS" />

With the retreat of the enemy, an uneasy [[Bakura Truce|truce]] between the Empire at Bakura and the Rebellion was forged. The political situation on Bakura however proved to be unstable and Governor Nereus used the situation for his advantadge. He infected Skywalker with parasites and handed him over to the Ssi-ruuk, again hoping to wipe them out. This resulted in a [[Battle of Bakura|second Invasion]] only two days later.<ref name="TTAB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Bakura first appeared in the novel ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''. The battle was conceived and written as an element within a step-stair plot structure by the author [[Kathy Tyers]]. Tyers used this battle as a device to introduce the nature of the [[Ssi-ruu]]vi threat along with two other important [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] players in the story plot—the Imperial commander [[Pter Thanas]] and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] slave [[Dev Sibwarra]].

During an [[Personal Influences Affect Bakura|interview]] with [[Ilene Rosenberg]] for [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 4]], Tyers said that her editor [[Janna Silverstein]] had asked her to have five concepts for the storyline. The one that Tyers liked the most involved an alien menace that would force the Rebel Alliance and the Empire to briefly work together.<ref name="AJ4">{{JournalCite|4|Personal Influences Affect Bakura|Personal Influences Affect ''Bakura''}}</ref>

There is some discrepancy between ''The Truce at Bakura'' and ''The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook'' regarding the IR-3F Patrol Craft: The Sourcebook claims that two of the five were destroyed during the siege with ''Digit/Bakura II'', ''III'' and ''V'' remaining, but the book mentions ''Digit/Bakura VI'' being destroyed in the final battle.
